definitions.explanation: The opening into which a plug, card, or connector is inserted. Used for electrical outlets, headphone jacks, USB ports, card slots, and similar receptacles.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
USB⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The USB port is on the back of the computer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{延長|えんちょう}コード→延長コード：07087_enchoukoodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This room has few outlets, so an extension cord is necessary.

notes:
⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧ (to insert, to plug in) + {口|ぐち} (opening). A plain, descriptive word for any hole something plugs into, so it works where a more specific term is unknown or unnecessary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}: power outlet
- ⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}: headphone jack
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧: to plug into the socket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コンセント→コンセント：04431_konsento⟧: electrical outlet — the everyday word for a wall socket specifically
- ⟦ポート→ポート：24425_pooto⟧: port — used for computer connectors in technical writing
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}み⟦プラグ→プラグ：07807_puragu⟧: plug — the part that goes in, not the opening
